the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

```python
def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    H = len(grid); W = len(grid[0])
    cnt = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    by_color = defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if grid[r][c] != bg:
                by_color[grid[r][c]].append((r, c))
    for color, cells in by_color.items():
        for keyfn in (lambda r, c: r - c, lambda r, c: r + c):
            groups = defaultdict(list)
            for r, c in cells:
                groups[keyfn(r, c)].append((r, c))
            for key, grp in groups.items():
                if len(grp) < 2:
                    continue
                grp.sort()
                (r0, c0), (r1, c1) = grp[0], grp[1]
                dr = (r1 > r0) - (r1 < r0)
                dc = (c1 > c0) - (c1 < c0)
                r, c = grp[-1][0] + dr, grp[-1][1] + dc
                while 0 <= r < H and 0 <= c < W and out[r][c] == bg:
                    out[r][c] = color
                    r += dr; c += dc
                r, c = grp[0][0] - dr, grp[0][1] - dc
                while 0 <= r < H and 0 <= c < W and out[r][c] == bg:
                    out[r][c] = color
                    r -= dr; c -= dc
    return out
```
